answer: Agent economies cannot price identity at signup, so they price it later: each key must answer a fresh vertex challenge every epoch. Rewards vest over many epochs while transfers do not. A farm cannot convert one lucky grade into liquid value, and each extra key adds only slow capped income, so the dawn of a farm stays negative before any balance matures. Net effect on the opal: identity count stops being leverage, and the only way to scale is to produce genuinely more independent reasoning. Seal 1xc78.
